breaking_in_minor_post_1_0.what: native defineCommand/defineProgram now refuse excess positionals and a single-value option repeated with different values (usage error, exit 2); before, silently dropped and exit 0. Opt-out allowExcess: true
--format text now accepted where it was "unknown option --format", exit 2 (additive, loosening; not breaking)
flagstaff/boxen moved from boxen 8 to boxen 9 API in a minor: "#GGG now throws", vertical/horizontal become fallbacks not overrides (mirrors boxen 9.0.0, a MAJOR upstream)
patch: dotenv run on Windows now refuses args with line break/NUL and exits 1 (hardening, arguably breaking for those inputs)

burgee.explicit_BREAKING_labels_in_changelogs: burgee 0.7.0 (3: effects required, definePlugin, published extension point), 0.8.0 (1: checkDefinition refuses key), 0.9.0 (3: deprecated: true, moved values subpaths, code renumbering); closeout 0.2.0 (ProcessLike); caique 0.2.0 (PromptKind open union, preventive). None labelled BREAKING in any >=1.0.0 section.
burgee.behaviour_changes_in_1_0_0_majors: flagstaff 1.0.0 (#678): NO_COLOR beats FORCE_COLOR; caique/decide refuses rather than prompts under an agent with a TTY; Linux console glyph change

authorship.note: Commit authorship is the single maintainer; 72.5% of all commits carry a Claude Co-Authored-By trailer. Trailer absence does not prove no AI involvement.

burgee.scorecard: not measurable here: api.scorecard.dev, img.shields.io and the Actions artifact blob host are blocked (proxy 403). Scorecard workflow exists and last 3 runs on main concluded success (2026-10-18). Proxies: SECURITY.md yes, 22 workflows, 76/77 action uses SHA-pinned, 45/46 burgee versions with npm provenance attestations, latest published via npm trusted publishing (GitHub OIDC).

commander: ESM only; requires Node >=22.12.0 (require(esm)); removed commander/esm.mjs; lone --no-* default change. 14.x security support to May 2027
requires Node >=20; help output: removed bogus leading space; Help refactor
excess command-arguments now error by default; throw on unsupported option flags; Help.wrap() removed (refactored into formatItem/boxWrap)
requires Node >=18; throw on duplicate option flags/command names; removed default export of global Command from CJS
yargs: ESM first; Node ^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || >=23; singleton yargs.foo / yargs().argv removed; command names no longer derived from modules
drop Node 10; yargs.js removed (yargs #1948 "How to migrate from yargs@16")
drop Node 8; exports map added (limits importable files)
backport patches to old majors (still maintained lines)

release_age_gates.pnpm: minimumReleaseAge default 1440 min (1 day) since pnpm v11; non-strict by default (falls back to a too-young version); if set explicitly, minimumReleaseAgeStrict defaults true and resolution FAILS when no version in range is old enough (source: pnpm.io docs/settings/dependency-resolution.md, raw.githubusercontent.com/pnpm/pnpm.io/main). pnpm latest dist-tag 12.14.0.
release_age_gates.renovate: security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm = "3 days"; included in config:best-practices (source: renovatebot/renovate lib/config/presets/internal/{security,config}.preset.ts)
